statements.notes: DIRECTIONS: Consume only on workout days. Mix 2 scoops (10 g) with 6 to 8 ounces prepared Beachbody(R) Hardcore Base Shake or a high-carbohydrate beverage (like grape juice) and consume within 30 minutes of intense exercise. For optimal results, use with Beachbody Hardcore Base Shake, Beachbody Fuel Shot, and Beachbody Super Suma.
ALLERGEN WARNING: Manufactured in a plant that also processes soy, egg, fish, crustacean shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, and wheat (gluten) ingredients.
STORAGE: Keep tightly closed in a cool, dry place.
